officialRevision: Perform simple and compound queries; Query with range and inequality filters on multiple fields

limits.officialText: Cloud Firestore limits a query to a maximum of 30 disjunctions in disjunctive normal form; this limit is fixed and cannot be changed
limits.notes: Counted on the canonical DNF of the filter. `in` and `array-contains-any` values contribute to this count and have no separate ID. Evaluated by Query::check_standard_limits on every query: refused under the strict profile, observed as an FS_LIMIT_OBSERVED warning under firebase, except that the official emulator refuses this one too, so it is refused under both (OFFICIAL_EMULATOR_REFUSES).

limits.officialText: You can use at most one array-contains clause per disjunction (or group)
limits.notes: Evaluated by Query::check_standard_limits on every query: refused under the strict profile, observed as an FS_LIMIT_OBSERVED warning under firebase, except that the official emulator refuses this one too, so it is refused under both (OFFICIAL_EMULATOR_REFUSES).

limits.officialText: You can't combine array-contains with array-contains-any in the same disjunction
limits.notes: Maximum 0 combinations per disjunction. Evaluated by Query::check_standard_limits on every query: refused under the strict profile, observed as an FS_LIMIT_OBSERVED warning under firebase.

limits.officialText: You can't combine not-in and != in a compound query
